newsitem.title: USA: Century Telephone closes Pecoco acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Century Telephone closes Pecoco acquisition.

text.p: Century Telephone Enterprises Inc said on Monday it completed the acquisition of Pecoco Inc, a provider of local exchange telephone services in Wisconsin.

Pecoco serves more than 7,600 telephone access lines with digital equipment and a fiber optic backbone network. Including this purchase, Century said it will serve more than 112,000 access lines in Wisconsin.

The company also owns a minority interest in two cellular partnerships serving Madison and Milwaukee representing about 35,000 pops, or the portion of the population of the service area based on ownership interest, the company said.
